note.zh: 双向局势：方式可随时切换（10之后“从远处监测”不再可选），两边的阶段事件各只在首次进入时触发一次。
note.en: A bidirectional situation: approaches can be switched (after 10 'Monitor it from Afar' is no longer offered); each stage event fires only the first time its stage is entered.

label.zh: 禁欲的奖励：时空异常矿藏

note.zh: 迷宫消失并留言，星球获得时空异常矿藏。
note.en: The labyrinth vanishes leaving a message; the planet gains a space-time anomaly deposit.

note.zh: 获得暗物质与稀有资源。
note.en: Grants dark matter and rare resources.

note.zh: 迷宫无痕消失，获得凝聚力。
note.en: It vanishes without a trace; grants unity.

note.zh: 平静离去，留下时空异常矿藏。
note.en: A quiet departure that leaves a space-time anomaly deposit.

note.zh: 同样留下时空异常矿藏，但星球多出火山、废墟与深坑障碍。
note.en: Also leaves the deposit, but adds volcano, ruin and sinkhole blockers.

notes.zh: 殖民地满4或5年时的随机殖民地事件（权重3/189、3/194），限非AI帝国的非首都、非人造星球；每局一次。选择“派队调查”设为“探索其内部”，“没有时间”设为“从远处监测”。
notes.en: Random colony event when a colony turns 4 or 5 (weights 3/189, 3/194), non-AI empires, non-capital non-artificial planets; once per game. 'Send a team' sets 'Explore its Interior', 'No time' sets 'Monitor it from Afar'.

notes.zh: （评注）这是双向局势：阶段事件按进度所到之处各只触发一次，并不顺序串联；图中的阶段连接均为已审阅的桥接。
notes.en: (Commentary) A bidirectional situation: stage events fire once each wherever progress reaches, not in sequence; every stage link shown is a reviewed bridge.

scope.zh: 全部结构（双向局势、阶段事件、21个月计时、五种结局）、源码与指南均已核对；阶段串联已用 noStageSequence 关闭。
scope.en: Whole structure (bidirectional situation, stage events, 21-month timer, five endings), source and guide checked; stage chaining switched off with noStageSequence.
